text: You don't speak Japanese... but your client just heard you in Japanese.
Someone just open-sourced a live interpreter, for any call on your computer.
And no bot joins the meeting.
Your client in Tokyo asks: "Can you send the price list by Friday?"
And you read it in English, live, as they say it.
Hold one key, and answer in English: "Yes, I'll send it Thursday."
Let go... and they hear it in Japanese. Right in the call.
And when the call ends? The notes are already written.
A summary. And a to-do: send the price list by Thursday.
Click it, and it jumps back to the exact moment they asked.
It's open source, with over three thousand stars on GitHub.
Send this to someone with clients abroad.
Comment CALL, and I'll send you the link.
